verdict.rationale: Pilot explicitly documents integrations with banking/payment/payroll tools (Bill.com, Stripe, Gusto, plus '10k+ integrations') that feed real-time transaction data into its bookkeeping, and a community customer confirms bank/credit-card/Expensify integrations automatically handle transaction classification. Missing for 10: independent verification of payroll-specific automatic sync beyond Gusto R&D credit mention, and no technical/API documentation of the integration mechanism.
